description: Let Claude Code and other services work in Greenlit with your permissions: everything the app does goes through the same API.
claudeBody: Run this once in a terminal. Claude can then browse the library, edit videos in the editor (open editors update live), leave notes and prepare posts.
tokensHint: A token acts as you. Give each service its own, and revoke the ones you no longer use.
